title: Album release: Ringo Starr & His All Starr Band Live 2006 by Ringo Starr | 2008
content:
Ringo Starr & His All Starr Band Live 2006, the tenth live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 7 July 2008, Starr’s 68th birthday.

Recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the All-Starr Band at the Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut, USA, on 16 July 2006, it was the 22nd show by the ninth All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

The music was recorded, mixed and mastered by Bruce Sugar at Sugarman Studios in Hollywood, and the photography was by Rob Shanahan and Henry Diltz.
